    StartersDinglehopper island fruit platterMango, pineapple and papaya wedges with passionfruit and limeHow to make it2 mangoes1/2 pineapple1/2 papaya3 passionfruits2 limes1 pinch salt1 pinch chilli flakesCut the mangoes, pineapple and papaya into wedges and halve the passionfruit.Mix the salt and chilli flakes.Pile the fruit on a platter, squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with the chilli salt.Plantain chipsThin fried green plantain chips with a coriander and lime sour cream dipHow to make it3 green plantains1 L vegetable oil, for frying1 tsp sea salt flakes2 limes1 handful coriander300ml sour creamPeel the plantains and slice them thin.Stir chopped coriander and lime juice through the sour cream for a dip.Fry at 180°C in the oil in batches until crisp.Salt well and serve with the dip.Grimsby's salmon and cucumber canapésGrimsby and the castle staffHow to make itAs written, serves 4Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and cucumber rounds with cream cheese.Warm 16 mocktail blinis at 180°C for 4 minutes.Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche, a fold of smoked salmon and a dill sprig.Cut 2 Lebanese cucumbers into thick rounds.Beat 150g cream cheese with lemon zest, chopped chives and pepper and pipe onto the cucumber.Top with a few capers.Arrange everything on a silver tray with lemon wedges.MainsCastle dinner jerk chickenGrilled chicken thighs in an allspice, thyme, chilli and lime paste, with riceHow to make it1kg chicken thighs1 tbsp ground allspice4 sprigs of thyme2 red chillies2 limes3 spring onions300g long grain rice1 can kidney beansBlitz the allspice, thyme, chilli, lime juice and spring onion into a paste.Marinate the chicken in the paste.Cook the rice with the drained kidney beans.Grill the chicken until charred and cooked through.Lagoon garlic lime prawns and coconut riceAriel and Eric's boat ride on the lagoonHow to make itAs written, serves 4Prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime butter until charred, served over coconut rice cooked with a pinch of salt.Rinse 1.5 cups jasmine rice and cook with a 400ml tin coconut milk, 200ml water and half a teaspoon salt, covered on low for 15 minutes, then rest 10.Melt 60g butter with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli and the zest of 1 lime.Toss 1kg peeled green prawns with oil and grill on high heat for 2 minutes a side until charred.Pour over the garlic butter and lime juice and serve on the rice with coriander.SweetsAriel's grotto jellyBlue jelly with mango and kiwi fish inside. Ursula keeps voices in shells.How to make it2 packets of blue jelly crystals1 mango2 kiwifruits300ml thickened creamCut the mango and kiwifruit into little fish shapes.Make up the jelly and pour into clear glasses with the fruit suspended inside.Chill until set.Whip the cream and spoon on top like sea foam.DrinksSebastian's seashell coconut coolerCoconut water and pineapple juice over ice with mint and limeHow to make it1 L coconut water1 L pineapple juice2 limes1 handful mint1 bag iceFill tall glasses with ice and mint leaves.Pour in equal parts coconut water and pineapple juice.Squeeze in a lime wedge, stir and serve cold.Sorrel and ginger punchKiss the Girl, lagoon and all.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
